dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt lists all detected imports as dependencies. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image, sets up the working directory, installs the dependencies from requirements.txt, copies the application code, and specifies the default command to run the Python script.
